entradas.text: On entering the building, we were met by a parliamentary guide who briefed us about the procedures. After a strict security screening, the staff ushered us to the third floor.

I, Deivid Wisci and the rest of the Sordish delegation to the Alliance of Nations arrived in Kyrute. The local police escorted us to the Alliance's headquarters in downtown Konstantium, immediately recognizable by its shining dome.
"Mr. President, it is my pleasure to return to this podium."
"When I last spoke here, the message I gave was of encouragement and support to this organization and the vital role it plays."
"Of all the challenges Eastern Merkopa and the whole world has faced since then, one has grown larger and more imminent than any other."
"The threat of the so-called 'socialist' states and the actions taken by their authoritarian rulers with no regard to international law."
A loud noise came from the table of Valgsland. I saw Emmerich Hegel pounding his fists on his table in protest.
"...Today, the need to come together as the leaders of the free world is more important than ever."
"The CSP, under the leadership of United Contana, has been fuelling Valgsland's military-industrial complex and its expansionist aims in Eastern Merkopa."
"The world cannot turn a blind eye to the increasing naval presence of Valgsland in the Markian Sea."
"According to our intelligence reports, United Contana-made nuclear missiles were quickly deployed to the island."
"We demand that the Chancellor speak the truth. As you can all see, we have evidence of the construction of silos."
"We hereby call for the immediate dismantling and withdrawal of all missiles and other offensive weapons from Heljiland."
Emmerich Hegel stood up and kept pounding his fists.
He pulled out a photograph. Even though it was hard to see from my position, I recognized it as an aerial image of Heljiland.
"We invite all the member states to support our call for a resolution in accordance with Article 11 of the Falenco Treaty."
A lot of noise came from the assembly hall in response. Most of the Western Merkopan delegates were clapping, while others either shouted in protest or sat in stony silence.
"We hereby call for the immediate withdrawal of all naval vessels with any offensive capability from international waters."
"Let's see how crazy this year's session will get."
"I'm surprised he isn't drunk."
entradas.menu: "I'm surprised he isn't drunk."

entradas.text: "Let's see..."
entradas.menu: "Let's see..."

entradas.text: I did not reply and kept listening to Alvarez.
entradas.menu: Ignore Deivid and listen to Alvarez's speech.

entradas.text: Deivid leaned in and spoke in a low voice.
Deivid chuckled.
"Look at that guy... He's an embarrassment."
entradas.menu: "Look at that guy... He's an embarrassment."

entradas.text: "Looks like the chancellor is already mad."
entradas.menu: "Looks like the chancellor is already mad."

entradas.text: I joined Hegel's protest and pounded my own fist on the table, which startled Deivid.
entradas.menu: Join in with the pounding.

entradas.text: I kept watching.
entradas.menu: Keep watching.

entradas.text: Deivid nodded.
The president of the assembly slammed his gavel down.
"Ahem..."
Deivid looked concerned.
"No Eastern Merkopan nation can accept the installation of weapons of mass destruction in the middle of our Markian Sea!"
"Do you think that's true?"
entradas.menu: "Do you think that's true?"

entradas.text: "Shit... This is huge."
entradas.menu: "Shit... This is huge."

entradas.text: "Bollocks."
entradas.menu: "Bollocks."

entradas.text: I kept listening.
entradas.menu: Keep listening.

entradas.text: "Honestly, this was always likely to happen. But so soon after the occupation? I didn't expect that."
"If that's true, it's a threat to all of us. I didn't expect them to be so quick after their operation."
"Let us also not forget about the recent events that transpired in an another state with socialist teachings. A state that wages war against its own innocent citizens. Wehlen."
"We hereby call the member states to action against Wehlen and its Sordish 'caretakers'."
"Their purge of the minorities in their country was, again, largely ignored by the international community. I would go as far to call it a genocide."
"That's a bunch of horseshit. Wehlen is not even socialist."
entradas.menu: "That's a bunch of horseshit. Wehlen is not even socialist."

entradas.text: "Right. Innocent citizens. He's forgetting the violence of the BFF."
entradas.menu: "Right. Innocent citizens. He's forgetting the violence of the BFF."

entradas.text: "He has a point."
entradas.menu: "He has a point."

entradas.text: I kept listening.
entradas.menu: Keep listening.

entradas.text: "Strictly speaking, Smolak's party is called the Wehzek Nationalist Party of Nurist *Socialism*..."
Deivid nodded disapprovingly.
Deivid nodded intently.
"Lespia was affected not only by the large wave of refugees coming from Wehlen, but by the subsequent government seizure of all of our companies that were active in the country."
"We hereby call the member states to action against Wehlen and its rogue government."
"Sordland violated our past treaties and gave support to this massacre with their armed forces, deploying them close to our borders."
"Wehlen violated our past treaties and mobilized their armed forces, deploying them close to our borders and authorizing them to partake in massacres."
"Thank you."
He walked back to his seat amidst enthusiastic applause from most of the Merkopan delegates.
I clapped.
entradas.menu: Clap.

entradas.text: "Honestly, that was not a bad speech."
entradas.menu: "Honestly, that was not a bad speech."

entradas.text: "You're embarrassing yourself, Alvarez!"
entradas.menu: "You're embarrassing yourself, Alvarez!"

entradas.text: I did not react to his speech.
entradas.menu: Don't react.

entradas.text: I pounded my fist on the table in protest and the Valgslandian delegates joined me.
entradas.menu: Pound your fist on the table in protest.

entradas.text: "I agree."
Deivid put a hand on my shoulder.
"Mr. President. No need to shout."
"We'll have our turn."
President Nines waited for the noise to calm down.
Smolak stood up. As he walked past Patricio Alvarez, he brushed him aside with an exaggerated sweep of his arms.
When he reached the podium, he fumbled with the microphone for a few seconds. Then, he smiled at Alvarez mockingly as he raised the height of it.
"Look at all the theatrics..."
entradas.menu: "Look at all the theatrics..."

entradas.text: "Wiktor's a funny guy."
entradas.menu: "Wiktor's a funny guy."

entradas.text: "I think the real chaos will start now."
entradas.menu: "I think the real chaos will start now."

entradas.text: I watched Smolak and waited for him to speak.
entradas.menu: Stay silent and wait for Smolak to start speaking.

entradas.text: Wiktor turned to President Nines and bowed slightly.
"The resources taken from these companies are being practically sold to Sordland."
"Yes, that's him."
"Indeed. A murderous comedian."
"Let's hope not."
"Mr. President."
He then turned back at us and stared out into the hall for a few seconds.
"Fellow delegates."
"It is true that the world today faces a multitude of challenges."
"In the midst of these challenges, the world's most powerful leaders gather here in Kyrute."
"And what do they do? They make threats. Promote hate and spread lies."
"Is this the Alliance of Nations we all want? Where is the cooperation and friendship? Where is the unity?"
"I want to remind you of the wars that the West fought on our soil... Of the foreign troops who occupied our country and seized our valuable resources."
"I want to remind you how they stole the oil from our sacred soil. And they did not know when to stop."
"The ATO soldiers left but their interference never ceased. They financed armed rebel groups whose only purpose is to create terror inside our country."
"So, fellow delegates! Don't you dare speak about Wehlen before you acknowledge your involvement in our civil war... Before you acknowledge your own dark past."
"He is not entirely wrong."
entradas.menu: "He is not entirely wrong."

entradas.text: "That's an empty argument. It doesn't justify what Wehlen did."
entradas.menu: "That's an empty argument. It doesn't justify what Wehlen did."

entradas.text: I kept watching.
entradas.menu: Keep watching.

entradas.text: "It's true that the western powers had their hands in the Wehlen Civil War, but it doesn't justify what they did to the Bludish."
"It's true that the western powers had their hands in the Wehlen Civil War, but it doesn't justify the operation."
"Sorry. You already know my take on dealing with him."
"What did you expect, Mr. President?"
"It's President Smolak..."

"As is well known, after the tremendous tragedy of the Wehlen Civil War, Arcasia made a deal with United Contana, where they agreed upon the withdrawal of their troops along with the removal of half of our army."
"Not only did they weaken us, we were left alone in facing the genocidal Bludish Freedom Front, which the ATO funds together with Rumburg."
"Just like the delegate before me, I will show you some of the evidence of foreign interference."
He picked up a large stack of papers and waved them back and forth.
"I will show you some of the evidence of foreign interference."
"These documents will be published everywhere. Copies have already been sent to the Investigative Affairs of the Alliance of Nations."
"I have clear evidence of direct aid from Rumburg to the Bludish Freedom Front. They smuggled tons of KA-74s in Wehlen. They smuggled in their spies. Smuggled in mercenary commanders."
"I expect this organization to do its task and investigate this properly, instead of leaving Wehlen behind as they have always done."
"He's finally talking about it. We're not the only ones now."
entradas.menu: "He's finally talking about it. We're not the only ones now."

entradas.text: "I should say something. Let Smolak know I'm on his side."
entradas.menu: "I should say something. Let Smolak know I'm on his side."

entradas.text: "Should I speak up and support him?"
entradas.menu: "Should I speak up and support him?"

entradas.text: I kept listening.
entradas.menu: Keep listening.

entradas.text: "It's true we need as many allies as possible if we're to take on Rumburg."
"He's got balls. Taking on Rumburg and the west like that."
entradas.menu: "He's got balls. Taking on Rumburg and the west like that."

entradas.text: Deivid nodded in agreement.
"But we can't be aggressive like Mr. Smolak here. We need the world powers with us, not against us."
"After how much we've achieved with Rumburg?"
"I thought we agreed on this. We don't want to create any conflict with Rumburg at this point."
"So it seems."
"Coming back to the claims of the Lespian representative... First, there is no evidence of civilian massacres by the Wehzek forces, nor so-called purges of minorities."
"Third, we know your government is also implicated in the funding of the BFF. And that your oil companies aided their militants during the operation."
"Fourth, as the state, we only took what was ours. The companies the delegate spoke of were not only aiding militants, they were brought to Wehlen by force."
"And lastly, Wehlen has no *caretaker.* Wehlen only has friends whom it cooperates with."
Then he looked at the Arcasian delegates and the Lespians next to them.
"...And enemies who want to keep it down."
"Know that Wehlen will no longer recognize the right of any other country to determine what type of weapons we are permitted to possess or what type of policies we follow within our borders."
"Wehlen stands stronger and more united than ever. Our people have spoken. The enemies inside our borders are crushed."
"Now, I ask every delegate here to read our report on the connections of the West with the armed militants in Eastern Merkopa. And I ask the Alliance of Nations to do what's right."
"Wehlen only wants peace. Our people want peace. They are counting on the support and understanding of all the nations of the world."
"Their proclamation is, 'Free Wehlen or Death'."
The assembly roared, with particularly loud applause coming from the seats of Rikan nations.
"Damn. That was a strong speech."
entradas.menu: "Damn. That was a strong speech."

entradas.text: "He seems to be popular with Rika, doesn't he?"
entradas.menu: "He seems to be popular with Rika, doesn't he?"

entradas.text: I did not react to his speech.
entradas.menu: Don't react.

entradas.text: I stood up and applauded.
entradas.menu: Stand up and applaud his speech.

entradas.text: I joined in with the applause.
entradas.menu: Applaud his speech.

entradas.text: Next, President Nines invited Maartin Van Hoorten to the podium. He walked up to the microphone with quick steps.
Wiktor slowly walked back to his seat as he applauded himself. He saluted the Rikan delegates as he passed them.
He was frowning and clenching his fists. I could almost see his jaw trembling.
"Seems like Maartin is not in the mood..."
entradas.menu: "Seems like Maartin is not in the mood..."

entradas.text: "He looks pissed."
entradas.menu: "He looks pissed."

entradas.text: "Uh-oh. It's Heljiland time."
entradas.menu: "Uh-oh. It's Heljiland time."

entradas.text: I watched Van Hoorten and waited for him to speak.
entradas.menu: Stay silent and wait for Van Hoorten to start speaking.

entradas.text: "Can you blame him? Valgsland has just occupied Heljiland."
"Can you blame him? His navy is being harassed by Valgsland every day now."
"Mr. President. Fellow delegates of the Assembly, and friends."
"It is an honor to be with you today."
"I wish we could meet under different circumstances."
"Once again, the CSP nations -- and in particular Valgsland -- have shown us what they're willing to do to achieve their political aims."
"I must first thank the delegates from Sordland for being brave enough to recognize our Heljiland, when the rest of the world left us alone."
"I must sadly say that the world has left us alone."
"I must first thank the delegates from Sordland for being brave enough to support Agnolia, when the whole world left us alone."
"We were one of the first countries to propose proper cooperation among Eastern Merkopan nations."
"Yet when we were threatened by Valgslandian expansionism, nobody came to our side."

"Although Mr. Alvarez voiced his indirect support for us earlier in today's session, I can't keep myself from wondering where he was when our lands were under invasion by the very *socialists* he spoke about."

"Although Mr. Alvarez voiced his indirect support for us earlier in today's session, I can't keep myself from wondering where he was when our fleets were under attack by the very *socialists* he spoke about."
"So, here I am, asking for the support of the fellow member states of the Alliance of Nations. Agnolia is under attack by Valgsland."
A loud banging noise emerged from the table of Valgslandian delegates. All of them were pounding their fists on their table.
I kept watching.
entradas.menu: Keep watching.

entradas.text: "Those delegates need to learn some respect."
entradas.menu: "Those delegates need to learn some respect."

entradas.text: I joined the protest and slammed both of my fists on the table.
entradas.menu: Join in with the pounding.

entradas.text: "Mr. President... Please."
"That's for sure."
"Mr. President, please moderate the assembly. This is more than disrespectful."
"As you all know, Heljiland -- which had been a territory of Agnolia for more than three decades -- was invaded by Valgsland in a sudden attack."
"Not only did they unlawfully occupy our land, they brought nuclear missiles to the island the moment our forces retreated."
"As you all know, our drilling ships, oil tankers and even fishing vessels have been disappearing in the Markian Sea. Captured or sunk by Valgsland."
"And the Valgslandian fleet is patrolling the seas around Heljiland with complete disregard to international laws."
"Another state from Eastern Merkopa now works with the CSP. Malenyevist terror surrounds us on all sides."
"In the midst of all this, Sordland -- which explicitly promised to support us -- has switched sides after hosting a meeting with Mr. Malenyev."
"I call on the Alliance of Nations to find a resolution to this never-ending conflict that Valgsland created. We demand the immediate withdrawal of all naval forces from our territorial waters."
"Malenyevist terror surrounds us on all sides."
"In the midst of all this conflict, Sordland gave United Contana docking rights in their largest naval base. That base currently holds an entire fleet from Contana."
"With the access given to them by Sordland, the United Contana-Valgsland united force is now roaming our seas. Malenyevist terror surrounds us on all sides."
"We must not falter. I invite all member states to find a resolution in accordance with Article 11 of the Falenco Treaty, enforcing the immediate dismantling of all missiles from Heljiland."
"I must also remind you that under Article 3 of the Ventrie City Treaty, the Alliance of Nations *must* ensure the withdrawal of the occupying force from the island."
"I call the democratic world to action. Against the tyranny of Malenyevism, authoritarianism, militarism and extremism."
The banging noise started again. Hegel stood up and approached the rostrum.
"You are a spineless jerk! A lackey of Arcasian imperialism!"
President Nines started hitting the gavel again.
I kept listening.
entradas.menu: Keep listening.

entradas.text: "What does he think he's doing?"
entradas.menu: "What does he think he's doing?"

entradas.text: "Look at the old man go."
entradas.menu: "Look at the old man go."

entradas.text: I stood up.
entradas.menu: Speak up in support of Hegel.

entradas.text: I stood up.
entradas.menu: Speak up in support of Van Hoorten.

entradas.text: "Mr. President! Chancellor Hegel has the right to intervene. Let him respond."
entradas.menu: "Mr. President! Chancellor Hegel has the right to intervene. Let him respond."

entradas.text: "Have some respect, Mr. Van Hoorten!"
entradas.menu: "Have some respect, Mr. Van Hoorten!"

entradas.text: "In the midst of all this conflict, Sordland gave its support to Valgsland and even aided their fleet with the invasion."
"With the intelligence and supply aid from Sordland, Valgsland's force is now roaming our seas. Malenyevist terror surrounds us on all sides."
"You're blaming everyone for your own incompetence! Don't bring Sordland into this!"
entradas.menu: "You're blaming everyone for your own incompetence! Don't bring Sordland into this!"

entradas.text: "Mr. President! Point of order! 'The Chancellor' has no right to intervene."
entradas.menu: "Mr. President! Point of order! 'The Chancellor' has no right to intervene."

entradas.text: "Have some respect, Mr. Hegel!"
entradas.menu: "Have some respect, Mr. Hegel!"

entradas.text: "Let him speak! What are you so afraid of that you won't even let him finish?"
entradas.menu: "Let him speak! What are you so afraid of that you won't even let him finish?"

entradas.text: "You have no right to intervene. Know your place, President Rayne!"
"President Nines... Please. What is this!?"
"All of your complaints against us are a direct result of your capitalist and neo-colonialist systems!"
President Nines smacked his gavel in vain as a shouting match broke out in the assembly.
Finally, after a few minutes, the other Valgslandian delegates convinced Hegel to sit back down.
"I believe I don't need to speak more about this subject. Everything is clear as day."
"Mr. Hegel's actions speak volumes about the reality of Valgsland and their corrupted ideology."
"I hope to see this conflict resolved with the help of the Alliance of Nations soon."
He quickly left the podium and nodded to the other Agnolian delegate. The two left the assembly hall.
Hegel immediately took his place and spoke in a low, seething tone.
"Thank you, Mr. President."
"Deivid, buckle up. It's the Chancellor's time now."
entradas.menu: "Deivid, buckle up. It's the Chancellor's time now."

entradas.text: I watched Hegel and waited for him to continue.
entradas.menu: Stay silent.

entradas.text: "It looks like you're having fun, Mr. President."
"Here we go..."
"First of all, I want to extend a due welcome to the new states from Rika that have joined this organization."
"As our numbers grow and more states are represented in this stage, we come ever closer to finding resolutions to the conflicts that plague us."
"After fighting for years against colonialism and imperialism, they more than earned our membership vote. I am overjoyed to see them finally represented in this assembly."
"For hundreds of years, the dominant economies of Merkopa razed, pillaged and exploited the continents of Rika and Xina."
"Sadly, Valgsland was also a part of this plunder in the years before the revolution, when it still clung to the idea of imperialism."
"But when our masses found their voice, the old colonial powers and their new financiers turned against them."
"These powers did whatever they could to hamper our revolutions. They did not want the people to be heard."
"They are scared of us for showing the possibility of a better path. Of course they don't want us to succeed. We threaten the *productivity* that runs on the blood and sweat of their working class."

"And now they have started labelling us the aggressors. Yet we all know it was the Arcasians who built up military bases all around Merkopa. It was the ATO that was first formed to fight against Malenyevism."
"Honestly, he's completely right."
entradas.menu: "Honestly, he's completely right."

entradas.text: "He's exaggerating."
entradas.menu: "He's exaggerating."

entradas.text: "Bullshit."
entradas.menu: "Bullshit."

entradas.text: I kept watching.
entradas.menu: Keep watching.

entradas.text: "Do you think so?"
"He's not entirely wrong."
"Heljiland was, is and will be Valgslandian territory. Our intervention in the island was completely justified."
"Other delegates brought up the Falenco and Ventrie City Treaties. However, they are forgetting about the Treaty of Adrium."

"Valgsland exercised its right to intervene on behalf of our people, who were being oppressed and massacred by the Agnolian government just because they did not recognize an appointed governor. They didn't get to elect one."
"We acted in full accordance with the second article of the treaty, If there's a side to be blamed, it is the state which murders its minorities for publicly showing support to our nation."
"There were also claims about illegal missiles."
"No country in the world has the right to determine what type of weapons we import."

"If there's a conflict the Alliance can resolve, let's start with the Arcasian base on Ravnos Island. Lespia has been housing Arcasian troops and missiles by our border for years and none of the member states even talked about it."
"The delegates from Lespia and Agnolia brought up the Falenco Treaty."
"Valgsland holds the right to protect its territorial waters and trade from threats."
"But what were they doing when ATO forces patrolled the Antacean Sea? They were silent."
"Just as no country in the world has the right to determine what type of naval vessels we use, no country can force us not to defend our seas."
"I also want the member states to look into the Arcasian bases in both Lespia and Sordland."
"I also want the member states to look into the Arcasian bases in Lespia."
"Perhaps then, there can be proper dialogue between our nations, and the Alliance of Nations can finally demonstrate that it can serve its intended purpose."
"Well said, Comrade Hegel..."
entradas.menu: "Well said, Comrade Hegel..."

entradas.text: Deivid looked at me as if he wasn't sure whether he heard me correctly.
"And what about Heljiland? How about the Valgs being killed by the Agnolian government because they protested against an appointed governor?"
"Agnolia has no right to claim they are upholding liberty and democracy. And the ATO has no right to intervene in the matters between Agnolia and Valgsland."
"It will certainly be remembered."
"Well, he played the victim here pretty strongly. And his anti-imperialist stance has definitely earned him sympathy from Rikans."
"Most of that continent has still not achieved stability after gaining their independence from their colonial suzerains."
"It's easy to forget it has only been a few years since the revolutions."
"But unfortunately, the Alliance of Nations remains all too willing to overlook such human rights violations."

"And if the Alliance of Nations truly claims to have the people's best interests at heart, they cannot stay silent about what the Agnolian government did in Heljiland. How they took away the rights of our people..."
"However, the Valgslandian government is ready as always to fight the forces of oppression and colonial servitude on behalf of free people everywhere."
"E'Rewoluten vez kore!"
"Was that Sordish? Did I catch that right?"
entradas.menu: "Was that Sordish? Did I catch that right?"

entradas.text: "Very similar to Sordish, right? Some words are even written the same way. But I'm surprised you caught that from his accent."
"He said 'the revolution will come', yes, but it was in old Valgish."
I stood up and applauded.
entradas.menu: Stand up and applaud his speech.

entradas.text: I did not react to his speech.
entradas.menu: Don't react.

entradas.text: I applauded.
entradas.menu: Applaud his speech.

entradas.text: Most of the delegates from Xina, Rika and Contana responded with thunderous applause.
"Second, the operation was limited only to the militant BFF, not the Bluds in general."
He looked at me.
He raised his left fist.
"Before I leave this stage, I also would like to extend a due welcome to Sordland, our newest entrant into the CSP. Another great nation now stands together with us."
Hegel shook hands with them as he walked back to his seat.
President Nines announced the next speaker: Queen Beatrice Livingston.
"Dear President of the Assembly, dear delegates, dear leaders of the world."
"Just as my fellow Eastern Merkopan delegates spoke about the troubles plaguing our continent..."
"...I also have to bring attention to a growing threat in our region. Sordland."
"...I also have to bring attention to a growing threat in our region. Sordland."
"...I also have to bring attention to the plight of the people of the north."
"Now they are ramping up their military forces. Their northern divisions have been mobilized. Military parades are taking place."
"These developments concern us greatly."
"As you know, not long ago, Sordish aircraft with offensive capabilities were spotted inside our borders."
"As you know, not long ago, Sordish aircraft with offensive capabilities were spotted inside our borders."
"A few days later, they shot down one of our planes inside our own airspace. It was practically an act of war."
"The pain of our people was never recognized. Not even when they faced the threat of genocide by the hands of the Sordish kings..."
"The Alliance of Nations, the ATO, the CSP and even the OMEC have never supported our people when they've been through tragic atrocities."
"Unlike many of the western countries here, we never received financial aid when natural disasters struck our lands."
"We always stood alone when embargoes and various unfair treaties were forced upon us."
"...One must admit that the activity of our Sordish neighbors has been very concerning."
"Not long ago, Sordland reinforced its forces along our borders."
"They took in traitors and gave them protection."
"Their president even went so far as to blame our country for spying on his administration. Through his own private secretary."
"And he expects the world to believe his lies."
"Their president himself came to power amid murder and unrest. Yet people from his administration had the guts to blame our government for inciting violence."
"And they expect the world to believe their lies."
I kept listening.
entradas.menu: Keep listening.

entradas.text: "That hag..."
entradas.menu: "That hag..."

entradas.text: "I can't let her speak about us like that."
entradas.menu: "I can't let her speak about us like that."

entradas.text: <shout>"MR. PRESIDENT! POINT OF ORDER!"!</shout>
entradas.menu: "MR. PRESIDENT! POINT OF ORDER!"

entradas.text: "Let's first hear her out."
"I hereby invite all of you to determine the initiation of a proper intergovernmental investigation into Sordland."
"It is also important to point out that Rumburg will not stand idly by if more Arcasian military are transferred to Eastern Merkopa."
"I hereby condemn both the ATO and Sordland for allowing Arcasia to settle in our region."
"It is also important to point out that Rumburg will not stand idly by if more Contanan military are transferred to Eastern Merkopa."
"I hereby condemn both the CSP and Sordland for allowing United Contana to settle in our region."
"It is also important to point out that Rumburg will not stand idly by if more Contanan and Arcasian military are transferred to Eastern Merkopa."
"I hereby condemn both the CSP and ATO for trying to influence our region with their military power."
"So today, I must show my due gratitude to the Sordish government for making peace with their dark past."
"They have finally agreed to grant reparations to our people who their kings have threatened with genocide."
"They extended their hand in friendship. And now, I'd like to extend ours."
"I propose a peace summit between our nations in order to eliminate the rising tensions once and for all."
I kept listening.
entradas.menu: Keep listening.

entradas.text: "That's good news."
entradas.menu: "That's good news."

entradas.text: "I didn't expect that from her."
entradas.menu: "I didn't expect that from her."

entradas.text: "Let's hear her out first."
"Know this. Rumburg will do anything in its power to defend itself and its interests. Whether Sordland is actually planning something or not..."
"Before I finish, I also want to say..."
"Mr. Smolak. I'm looking forward to reading your report. I wonder what this so-called 'evidence' is all about."
"Know that your slander does not work on us. Know that we are ready to die for our freedom. Know that our kingdom stands firm and strong."
"Expect a grand awakening..."
"Thank you."
"If the Alliance continues to shirk its given duties, you can trust in Rumburg to take matters into her own hands."
"Grand awakening?"
entradas.menu: "Grand awakening?"

"Mr. Chancellor, please let me finish. We did not interrupt you when you addressed the assembly."
"I must also raise my concerns about the threat that Rumburg poses to Eastern Merkopa."
"The speakers who preceded me clearly showed that tensions are rising. The reports from Wehlen and Sordland are troubling."
"The representatives from both countries referred to KA-74s being smuggled within their borders."
"Mr. Rayne also pointed out the construction of nuclear weaponry in Rumburg. Our intelligence also confirms this."
"Arcasia and the ATO will stand against the aggression of Rumburg. They are playing a dangerous game. One that may bring ruin to Merkopa and their own lands."
"I believe the Alliance of Nations can find a resolution to this conflict as well. If not, let it be known that Arcasia will stand together with Sordland. Rumburg cannot do as it pleases."
"Finally, I propose that the Alliance of Nations undertake the noble cause of helping the people of the world through rewriting and properly enforcing its Human Rights Declaration."
"Do you think Rumburg can pursue any more aggression after that statement?"
entradas.menu: "Do you think Rumburg can pursue any more aggression after that statement?"

entradas.text: "That's great news. I hope he means it."
entradas.menu: "That's great news. I hope he means it."

entradas.text: "Nice."
entradas.menu: "Nice."

entradas.text: I kept listening.
entradas.menu: Keep listening.

entradas.text: "I doubt that. With our membership in ATO and Arcasia's clear support... The Queen needs to be crazy to try anything."
"This is definitely good news. Arcasia's showing clear support for us."
"The Alliance of Nations cannot survive as a static organization. Its size and duties are increasing enormously. It should adapt to the changing world."
"But peace and rights do not rest in the hands of this organization alone. They rely on the hearts of our people and the spirit of cooperation between our nations."
"So, let it be known, my fellow inhabitants of this world... Let us take our stand and see if we can finally achieve a lasting peace."
"Thank you."
I did not react to his speech.
entradas.menu: Don't react.

entradas.text: I stood up and applauded.
entradas.menu: Stand up and applaud his speech.

entradas.text: I applauded.
entradas.menu: Applaud his speech.

entradas.text: "That would be the destruction of the planet."
The applause continued for some time. Walker shook hands with various delegates on his way back to his seat.
Most of the assembly applauded his speech, the ATO delegates in particular.
"Yes... I hope we won't be seeing a direct war between the superpowers any time soon..."
"That speech had very dangerous connotations to it."
entradas.menu: "That speech had very dangerous connotations to it."

entradas.text: President Nines spoke into the microphone once more.
Malenyev slowly walked to the rostrum in his iconic suit. All of the CSP delegates stood up and applauded him.
"Honorable chairman and fellow delegates to the Alliance of Nations."
"Here we are again at the most esteemed meeting of state representatives in the world."
"However, increasingly, we are being threatened, disregarded, attacked or ignored in this assembly."
"The representative of Arcasia has just shown this unfriendly attitude towards us yet again."
"Arcasia would have you believe we are standing in the way of lasting peace. Yet, the peace they talk about was only possible thanks to our missiles and our growing base in the developing world."
"The ATO kept waging wars against people's revolutions and forcing new independent states to be their puppets. Binding them to themselves through the Arcasian Lira."
"And now yet another Arcasian president is telling us that we are the aggressors and they are the keepers of peace."

"We will not be silent anymore against these lies! When was this peace you talk about? Where was this cooperation between our countries? Have you ever accepted our invitation to talk about de-nuclearization?"
"If you don't like us, don't accept our deals, don't listen to our concerns, and keep pointing fingers at us, why did you invite us to the Alliance of Nations?"
"Every year, United Contana comes to this assembly to address the real problems of *real* people. People who suffer because of your systems, your wars and your ignorance."
"Whether you like it or not, we'll keep representing the laborers, the slaves, the oppressed of this world. And believe it or disregard it, history is on our side."
"We say to the representatives of capitalist countries... Come and visit us. Come and see the revolution working in Contana."
"Show our continent to your people without distorting the reality. If you cannot do that, then you need not come."
"We believe socialism will triumph over capitalism in the end. Such is the logical conclusion of the development of humankind."
This time, the Lespian delegates started laughing very loudly. Some other delegates booed.
I kept watching.
entradas.menu: Keep watching.

entradas.text: "Ridiculous..."
entradas.menu: "Ridiculous..."

entradas.text: "Malenyev's living in his dreams."
entradas.menu: "Malenyev's living in his dreams."

entradas.text: I also laughed with the Lespian delegates.
entradas.menu: Join in with the laughing.

entradas.text: "Malenyev or the laughing?"
"Both."
entradas.menu: "Both."

entradas.text: "Malenyev's remarks."
entradas.menu: "Malenyev's remarks."

entradas.text: "The laughing, of course."
entradas.menu: "The laughing, of course."

entradas.text: "You think?"
"You can keep laughing, gentlemen. Communism will bury you."
"If you really believe in cooperation, we will be waiting! We're not going anywhere."
Suddenly the laughing turned into shouting.
"However, if the ATO keeps intervening in our matters... It is natural that the CSP would react."
"Before we move on, we also would like to extend a warning to Rumburg."
"The representatives from both Wehlen and Sordland referred to KA-74s being smuggled into their countries."
"Mr. Rayne also pointed out the construction of nuclear weaponry in Rumburg. Our intelligence also confirms this."
"United Contana and the CSP will stand against the aggression of Rumburg. They are playing a dangerous game. One that may bring ruin to Merkopa and their own lands."
"I hope the Alliance of Nations can find a resolution to this conflict. If not, let it be known that United Contana will do whatever it takes to protect the people of Sordland and Eastern Merkopa."
"Despite threats from the ATO, Rumburg or any other nation or organization, we must not succumb to further division and violence."
"That's great news. I hope he means it."
entradas.menu: "That's great news. I hope he means it."

entradas.text: "Do you think Rumburg can pursue any more aggression after that statement?"
entradas.menu: "Do you think Rumburg can pursue any more aggression after that statement?"

entradas.text: "Nice."
entradas.menu: "Nice."

entradas.text: "I doubt that. With our membership in CSP and Contana's clear support... The Queen needs to be crazy to try anything."
"This is definitely good news. Contana's showing clear support for us."
I kept listening.
entradas.menu: Keep listening.

entradas.text: "We must ask ourselves, what do the people of our countries expect of us? They surely don't want war and bloodshed."

"So let us leave to our children and grandchildren, good memories of our time and a better future for all. Let them look at history and say: once there were great divisions and complex problems, but the leaders of the world came together in the Alliance of Nations and succeeded in settling them in order to ensure our peaceful lives."
"Let us act in such a way to make this session not a session of threats, but a session of hopes. And the realization of them."
"The government of United Contana and the united peoples of Contana are ready to serve their duties for world peace."
"Long live the people's revolution."
"Long live the revolution!"
entradas.menu: "Long live the revolution!"

entradas.text: "That was a great speech."
entradas.menu: "That was a great speech."

entradas.text: The assembly broke into massive applause.
I did not react to his speech.
entradas.menu: Don't react.

entradas.text: "I'm just very concerned about the rising tensions between them and Arcasia..."
I stood up and applauded.
entradas.menu: Stand up and applaud his speech.

entradas.text: I applauded.
entradas.menu: Applaud his speech.

entradas.text: "Mr. President, what are you doing?"
The applause continued for some time. Malenyev slowly walked back to his seat.
"That was.... A lot."
"It definitely was."
entradas.menu: "It definitely was."

entradas.text: "It was troubling. Tensions are too high."
entradas.menu: "It was troubling. Tensions are too high."

entradas.text: "Yeah.  Let's grab some lunch."
entradas.menu: "Yeah. Let's grab some lunch."

entradas.text: "Lead the way."
"It's quite scary, to be honest. We need to be careful."
We walked out of the hall to have some lunch and fresh air.
We entered the massive circular assembly hall and took our designated seats. Deivid sat next to me.
After a short opening speech, President Nines called the first speaker to the floor.
"It is my great pleasure to invite the Prime Minister of Lespia to address the assembly."
Patricio Alvarez stood and walked up to the podium as the assembly applauded.
"In light of all that, I implore this Alliance to take a closer look at the actions of our southern neighbors."
"The world turned a blind eye when the armies of Valgsland occupied Heljiland. And they did not stop there."
"All of the world's most powerful people under one gleaming dome."
"One wrong word and the world will go to hell."
entradas.menu: "One wrong word and the world will go to hell."

entradas.text: "I'm glad to be among them."
entradas.menu: "I'm glad to be among them."

entradas.text: "It's amazing how someone has managed to fill a room with people that absolutely loathe each other."
entradas.menu: "It's amazing how someone has managed to fill a room with people that absolutely loathe each other."

entradas.text: "It is truly astounding. Humanity has come far."
"How are you feeling, Anton? Ever since the assassination attempt, I'm amazed that you've been holding up so well."
"High pressure, I know. Just believe in yourself, Anton. From what I have seen, you will do just fine."
"We managed... somehow."
entradas.menu: "We managed... somehow."

entradas.text: "But it must have been tough for Mrs. Rayne and the kids."
"Still having nightmares about it. I just hope that whatever I decide, it won't put Monica and the children in front of the barrel of a gun."
entradas.menu: "Still having nightmares about it. I just hope that whatever I decide, it won't put Monica and the children in front of the barrel of a gun."

entradas.text: "It comes with the job. Monica and I already came to terms with the risk after the inauguration ball."
entradas.menu: "It comes with the job. Monica and I already came to terms with the risk after the inauguration ball."

entradas.text: "It is tough to be the president."
"We knew changing Sordland would be hard. But we could never expect it to be this way."
entradas.menu: "We knew changing Sordland would be hard. But we could never expect it to be this way."

entradas.text: "Making harsh decisions and dealing with their consequences."
"I wish I could have supported you more, but time has been a cruel mistress."
"How are you feeling, Anton? Ever since what happened to Petr, I'm amazed that you've been holding up so well."
"I remember how inseparable the two of you were in university. "
"He was a true friend. I hope that he is in a better place now."
entradas.menu: "He was a true friend. I hope that he is in a better place now."

entradas.text: "I managed... somehow."
entradas.menu: "I managed... somehow."

entradas.text: "He was more of a friend to me than I ever was to him. I wish I had done more to help him."
entradas.menu: "He was more of a friend to me than I ever was to him. I wish I had done more to help him."

entradas.text: "That was before I knew who he really was. If I'd known, I never would have made him Vice President."
entradas.menu: "That was before I knew who he really was. If I'd known, I never would have made him Vice President."

entradas.text: "How are you feeling, Anton? Being the subject of so much media attention must take a toll on you and the family."
"We knew changing Sordland would be hard. But we could never have expected it to be this way."
entradas.menu: "We knew changing Sordland would be hard. But we could never have expected it to be this way."

entradas.text: "We're managing... somehow."
entradas.menu: "We're managing... somehow."

entradas.text: "Well, the session is about to start. Let's get comfortable. It's going to be a long day."
"I'm managing... somehow."
entradas.menu: "I'm managing... somehow."

entradas.text: "It comes with the job. Monica and I already came to terms with the risk after the inauguration ball."
entradas.menu: "It comes with the job. Monica and I already came to terms with the risk after the inauguration ball."

entradas.text: "What you have done so far is more than enough. Don't treat yourself so harshly."
entradas.menu: "What you have done so far is more than enough. Don't treat yourself so harshly."

entradas.text: "For what it's worth, I appreciate all the advice you've given me."
entradas.menu: "For what it's worth, I appreciate all the advice you've given me."

entradas.text: "Don't worry about it."
entradas.menu: "Don't worry about it."

entradas.text: From a distance, we could see the president of the general assembly, Mr. Nines, approaching his designated position.
"Your advice wasn't that good anyway."
entradas.menu: "Your advice wasn't that good anyway."

entradas.text: "Everyone's words and actions here will change the world, for better or worse."
"Hm."
"Thank you, Anton."
"If the AN truly wanted world peace it would arm itself and enforce such conditions. Where is your spine for God's sake!?"
entradas.menu: "If the AN truly wanted world peace it would arm itself and enforce such conditions. Where is your spine for God's sake!?"

entradas.text: "Let's get our shit together and sort out this mess of a divided house once and for all or be swallowed by discord."
entradas.menu: "Let's get our shit together and sort out this mess of a divided house once and for all or be swallowed by discord."

entradas.text: "Together with Wehzek forces, Sordish Armed Forces partook in massacres of innocent Bludish people."
"Sordland closed their borders to innocent Bludish people fleeing from being massacred by the Wehzek forces."
"They even supported and cooperated with Wehlen in their ethnic war against the Bludish people."
"And inside their country, they've been oppressing and killing innocent civilians -- just because they belong to a different culture."
"I wish to extend my support to Governor Ersen of Bludia, and all the Bludish people that has to go through tragic atrocities being committed by the Sordish authorities."
"Know that you are not alone. Millions are watching your brave fight for freedom. Rumburg is ready to support you."
"And inside their country, they've been targeting innocent civilians under the guise of fighting terrorism."
"I wish to extend my sympathies to all Bludish people that had to go through the tragic atrocities being committed by the Sordish authorities."
"And inside their country, they've been systematically pushing the Bludish people away from representation."
"I wish to extend my sympathies to the banned Bludish organizations and all Bludish people that have to live through the oppression of the Sordish authorities."
"And inside their country, the Bludish people are rebelling against the oppressive rule of the Sordish government."
"I wish to extend my sympathies to all Bludish people that have to live through the tragic atrocities being committed by the Sordish authorities."
"Know that you are not alone. Millions are watching your brave fight for freedom. Rumburg is ready to support you."
"And inside their country, they killed hundreds of Bludish people who wanted to be free from Sordish oppression."
"I wish to extend my sympathies to all Bludish people that had to live through the tragic atrocities being committed by the Sordish authorities."
"Gentlemen. I beg you to show some restraint."
"The next speaker will be Wiktor Smolak, President of Wehlen."
"Order!"
"Order?! There will only be order when this coward stops smearing Valgsland's good name!"
"Silence, Chancellor. Mr. Prime Minister, please continue."
Nines repeatedly banged his gavel.
<shout>"ORDER!"</shout>
"The next speaker on the list is Emmerich Hegel of Valgsland."
"Mr. Chancellor, I will remind you to respect the principles of civility and decorum in these halls."
"Overruled, Mr. President. Please wait for Her Excellency to finish speaking."
"This is not the forum for such arguments. President Rayne, please continue."
<shout>"SILENCE!"</shout>
"We have one final speaker before the break. Leon Malenyev of United Contana."
"Thank you, ladies and gentlemen. We will reconvene later in the day for the final agenda items and closing remarks."
Deivid stood and stretched his arms.
"We paid reparations. What more does she want?"
"I have indicated my willingness to forge a lasting peace with our northern neighbors. Yet Queen Beatrice insists on painting Sordland as the aggressor."
